# (or db.install_labels(Class) in your code). Foreign key columns stay as plain properties.

from uuid import uuid4

from neomodel import (
    BooleanProperty,
    DateTimeProperty,
    IntegerProperty,
    JSONProperty,
    One,
    RelationshipFrom,
    RelationshipTo,
    StringProperty,
    StructuredNode,
    UniqueIdProperty,
    ZeroOrMore,
    ZeroOrOne,
)


class BlogUser(StructuredNode):
    """Model BlogUser (table blog_user)."""

    id_ = UniqueIdProperty(db_property="id")
    created_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="createdAt")
    updated_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="updatedAt")
    author_blog_posts = RelationshipFrom("BlogPost", "AUTHOR", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)
    editor_blog_posts = RelationshipFrom("BlogPost", "EDITOR", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)
    blog_profile = RelationshipFrom("BlogProfile", "USER", cardinality=ZeroOrOne)


class BlogCategory(StructuredNode):
    """Model BlogCategory (table blog_category)."""

    id_ = UniqueIdProperty(db_property="id")
    created_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="createdAt")
    updated_at = DateTimeProperty(required=True, db_property="updatedAt")
    name = StringProperty(max_length=100, unique_index=True, required=True)
    slug = StringProperty(max_length=50, required=True)
    parent_id = StringProperty(db_property="parentId")
    parent = RelationshipTo("BlogCategory", "PARENT", cardinality=ZeroOrOne)
    blog_categories = RelationshipFrom("BlogCategory", "PARENT", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)
    blog_posts = RelationshipFrom("BlogPost", "CATEGORY", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)


class BlogTag(StructuredNode):
    """Model BlogTag (table blog_tag)."""

    id_ = UniqueIdProperty(db_property="id")
    label = StringProperty(max_length=50, required=True)
    created_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="createdAt")
    updated_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="updatedAt")
    blog_posts = RelationshipFrom("BlogPost", "TAGS", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)


class BlogPost(StructuredNode):
    """Model BlogPost (table blog_post)."""

    id_ = UniqueIdProperty(db_property="id")
    created_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="createdAt")
    updated_at = DateTimeProperty(required=True, db_property="updatedAt")
    public_id = StringProperty(
        unique_index=True,
        default=lambda: str(uuid4()),
        db_property="publicId",
    )
    title = StringProperty(max_length=200, index=True, required=True)
    body = StringProperty(required=True)
    status = StringProperty(
        choices={"draft": "DRAFT", "published": "PUBLISHED"},
        index=True,
        default="draft",
    )
    rating = StringProperty()
    view_count = IntegerProperty(default=0, db_property="viewCount")
    is_featured = BooleanProperty(default=False, db_property="isFeatured")
    published_at = DateTimeProperty(
        default_now=True,
        index=True,
        db_property="publishedAt",
    )
    metadata = JSONProperty(required=True)
    author_id = StringProperty(index=True, required=True, db_property="authorId")
    editor_id = StringProperty(db_property="editorId")
    category_id = StringProperty(required=True, db_property="categoryId")
    author = RelationshipTo("BlogUser", "AUTHOR", cardinality=One)
    editor = RelationshipTo("BlogUser", "EDITOR", cardinality=ZeroOrOne)
    category = RelationshipTo("BlogCategory", "CATEGORY", cardinality=One)
    tags = RelationshipTo("BlogTag", "TAGS", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)


class BlogProfile(StructuredNode):
    """Model BlogProfile (table blog_profile)."""

    id_ = UniqueIdProperty(db_property="id")
    bio = StringProperty()
    avatar = StringProperty(max_length=100)
    created_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="createdAt")
    updated_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="updatedAt")
    user_id = StringProperty(unique_index=True, required=True, db_property="userId")
    user = RelationshipTo("BlogUser", "USER", cardinality=One)
